Good afternoon. Can I help you?
Good afternoon. Excuse me, how much is this?
The blue dress? It is forty-five pounds.
We do. We have it in black and in green. Same price.
And what sizes do you have?
Small, medium and large. Would you like to pop into the fitting room and try it on?
Sorry, I don't understand. Can you say that again, please?
Of course. Do you want to try it on? The room is over there.
Yes, please. Medium, in black. And how much are those shoes?
Those are eighty pounds. They are new this week.
Thank you. The shoes are too expensive for me today. Only the dress, please.
No problem at all. The fitting room is on your right. I am here if you need another size.
That is too expensive for me today. Thank you anyway.

Good afternoon, and welcome to the store. We have a few things to tell you this afternoon. All dresses on the first floor are thirty percent off until Sunday. Shoes are on the second floor, and they are not in the sale this week. If you want to try something on, the fitting rooms are at the back, on your right, and there is no limit of pieces. If you need a different size or a different color, please ask any person with a green shirt. We are happy to look in the back for you. And if you buy something today and you change your mind, you can return it in thirty days, with the tag and the receipt. Thank you for shopping with us.

Hello, this is a message from the store on Oxford Street, for Patricia. You asked us about the blue dress in a large size. Good news: it arrived this morning, and I have one here for you. I keep it at the desk with your name on it until Friday. If you come, please ask for Ryan, and bring the receipt of the black one if you want to change it. One more thing you asked about: the shoes are now in the sale, so they are sixty pounds and not eighty. If Friday is not possible for you, call us and we keep the dress for one more week. Thank you, and see you soon.
Excuse me. How much is this dress? Do you have it in another color? Can I try it on, please? Thank you very much.
